pr_title: Add AppVeyor CI & fix tests on Windows
pr_body:
**PR:**
- Added AppVeyor config. Will need to be toggle on (@devongovett)
- Fixed broken tests on Windows (css, glob, javascript, watcher, html and hmr)
- The changes proposed in #159 fix the failing stylus tests

**Notes:**
- Most issues were path related to Window's vs Unix paths (`\` vs `/`). Need to leverage `path.join()` going forward over string concatenation for compatibility.
- Odd formatting is from `prettier`

**Closes #174**
pr_comments: Note: Waiting on #159 to be merged
@davidnagli #159 landed. This should be good to go now.

**Choose one:**         🐛

### 🤔 Expected Behavior

Tests pass on all platforms.

### 😯 Current Behavior

Currently, ~50% of the tests are failing on Windows ([see AppVeyor results](https://ci.appveyor.com/project/brandon93s/parcel)). Some of these are due to a failure in a `beforeEach` hook, but others are legitimate failures. **The test failures could mean that `parcel` isn't working correctly on Windows. (e.g. #86)**


### 💁 Possible Solution

1) Add AppVeyor alongside Travis.ci
2) Start working through and correcting the failures

### 🌍 Your Environment
<!--- Include as many relevant details about the environment you experienced the bug in -->

Occurring on Windows 10 (local) and Windows Server 2012/2016 (AppVeyor).
Occurring on Node.js v9.2.0 (local) and Node.js v8.x.x (AppVeyor).

review_comments:
Windows "randomly generated" class is not `1ezyc`. Update tests to:

- Check for the pattern `_index_[0-9a-z]+_1`
- Extract the found pattern to find it in the output css
hmm, this seems weird actually. URLs should always use `/`. Might be a bug.

Styling prettier is applying here is kinda hard to read, so to explain:

Check for `\` OR `/` in the path. It will be different on Windows vs Other.

`\` is an escape in regex; converting to unix style paths here. The `glob` module does the transform internally but `micromatch` doesn't. Doing it here ensures consistency. This was more than just the tests, globs didn't work on Windows.
